author: TeIq
content:
PR 2 closed. The previous attempt (a5c7db6) landed with an incomplete codegen output because #101's lexicons used invalid `"type": "number"` (fixed in 8bd63a6, see #101 thread). With the lexicon spec corrected, the codegen now emits all 7 generated files for all 3 lexicons.

## What landed (commits)
- a5c7db6: initial polaris-lexicons crate + xtask + CI scaffolding (incomplete codegen output)
- 8bd63a6: #101 lexicon fix (scaled-integer for confidence/similarityScore/weight)
- THIS commit: regenerate the full codegen tree + add proto-blue-syntax workspace dep + re-export the namespace at crate root

## Verification (architect-run, not subagent-claimed)
- `cargo build -p polaris-lexicons` — clean
- `cargo clippy -p polaris-lexicons -- -D warnings` — clean
- `cargo build --target wasm32-unknown-unknown -p polaris-lexicons` — clean (AC-4)
- `cargo xtask gen-lexicons` idempotent — zero diff on the second invocation

## Generated tree
```
polaris-lexicons/src/generated/
├── mod.rs
└── gay/
    ├── mod.rs
    └── dollspace/
        ├── mod.rs
        └── polaris/
            ├── mod.rs
            ├── escalation.rs
            ├── evidencePointer.rs
            └── observation.rs
```

## AC results
- [x] AC-2 (codegen idempotency): cargo xtask gen-lexicons produces zero diff on second run
- [x] AC-4 (wasm32 build): polaris-lexicons builds for wasm32-unknown-unknown
- [x] Doc-comment lint: cargo doc -p polaris-lexicons --no-deps -- -D warnings clean
